We think this will add a lot of personality and value to outdoor Sci-fi and Cyberpunk maps.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/748/194/c852fb7c38c989cee2a3e73b90d47c89_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682603691&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=2349438c089b0892bfc57518f8222e77[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/748/199/659cc3ed718a705c85424e80f0d93d47_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682603733&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=f991de7130f6b80bdfff4ff55b468a97[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/748/213/e0f53bf063f4499ade37bd182f8af5a4_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682603798&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=d019ba76f2304d96079cc1a1d6dff7a1[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/748/215/b440a1a79ec48ae5336ab99f4e9e744f_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682603826&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=ee78ee2247c18bf1c0b8a5874c3b107f[/img]

Well, what do you think?


[h1]2. - We are listening to your feedback!![/h1]

But that's not all! NOT AT ALL!!

As you all know, we've been active on the discord server, listening to your feedback and bug reporting. This time we're tackling something you've been asking for some time now: The User Interface! (Well, alongside a few more quality of life updates, as always 😊).

[b]Chronos looks different! Much cooler now :) [/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/747/246/6d4f9e957b930bc224e4d02b0f603a6f_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682598321&gif-q=50&q=92&s=7c9581c1f3bf2da49283d528b2ee6cb7[/img]

For some time now we've been re-designing the layout of the UI and with this update it finally gets unveiled. We focused on a more minimalistic look that's easier to read while also keeping all of the functionality we already had.

For starters the new directory system lets you navigate different Environment folders for each of the available Settings. This way you can filter through assets much faster without resorting to the search menu.

Oh and we added a "New Assets" folder to display all of the recently added goodies 👀. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/747/280/13bac5abf7b3a57652d3fe6350468f60_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682598652&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=14c0875903c9d05e5c50cb95d64fbec3[/img]

The library items are now organized using a pagination system, which has resulted in significant performance improvements. You can still use the mouse scroll to move through different pages or use the new slider graphic. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/747/288/2c2d5ff002c8a8e2756b5bb6db09f35f_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682598804&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=32962777a8901cb866a8d3bb18809445[/img]

The taskbar is now static and has a much more simplified look to it. We generally cleaned up the screen space to let you focus on what matters: Making new maps! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/747/296/57605251d8e875ed087b67e2b83dfdbc_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682598925&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=276e9b8d518b4ec0205f02a83d41c4a1[/img]

Command Tips and descriptions now have a dedicated section in the UI! Whereas before they'd take up the Tweaks Menu spot and fill a big chunk of your screen, they will now pop up over the library bar. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/747/304/e9e92cf7214e5304ab3e79a586534147_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682599000&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=fe87ddf4dcb9812b37d220d65d9e4889[/img]

There's more to come but we didnt want to make you wait any longer to experience these changes! Our focus is on finishing the rest of the UI overhaul before the next month is over. We'll tackle the rest of the tool menus and tweaks next. We already have a lot of plans for those!

[h1]Multiple other performance and Quality of Life improvements[/h1]

Yes. There is more. A LOT MORE!

The maximum frames per second have been limited to 30 for “Low” quality settings and 60 for all other settings. There has been an improvement in performance.

You can now cancel item spawn actions and autobuilder selection by tapping the right mouse button. As always, you can still do so by pressing "Esc" or by clicking outside the grid bounds.

[h1]3. - New Autobuilder Improvements[/h1]

As we promised, the Autobuilder too is getting an update!

We focused on the correct placement of props first. They should have much better compositions now.

Here are some examples of autogenerated rooms.  Granted, we rotated some assets, but the rest is what we got :)

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/748/160/57c2558a0364b0fa29e4180a032e5c20_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682603496&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=d9012c4bddc13eb1f6319d3b39e60c67[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/748/162/e40fd4427482f5e5050173fef9e41fc6_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682603508&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=74aa479393007462e4dce3f76988a279[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/748/164/556178bc68e54e40c3fda50bee5611ba_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682603524&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=cf3c8be6accf777fad1ee397bb2e24dc[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/748/168/ca2e8872e262fc05483bb8f425e2020c_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682603540&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=8ca77772e51668912c3d01ba40620ff8[/img]
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/748/171/075b5d8d249b6da4c007c9266a3994b1_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682603560&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=7690a9bbefe5eab3797d23200ee0cbe9[/img]

We wouldn't call this version 2.0 just yet, as we still need to finetune the placement of doors and windows a bit more, but we feel like this is a step in the right direction. 

At the moment, some room types work better with the algorithm, such as Medieval Tavern, Victorian Attic or Cyberpnuk Industrial storage rooms. 

We have "room" for improvements! :)

 Stay tuned! 

[h1]4.- What's next?
[/h1]
Here are our plans for the next set updates!

[b]- Only the last stretch goal left! :[/b] You heard that right, we only have one Cyberpunk environment pack left to deliver from the original kickstarter campaign. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/747/390/232c4d47a05311199e8b8441cf6fe4b5_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1682599565&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=5031fe6178745bb06b49a6a139a1c819[/img]

[b]- Continue updating the UI: [/b]As we said earlier, there's still work left to do but the most crucial parts have been already addressed. We'll tackle the rest of tool menus and the tweaks menu next, then the main configuration windows.

[b]- More Autobuilder Improvements:[/b] We plan to focus on placing the doors in more desirable positions and improving the algorithm for some of the rooms available.

[b]- Continue listening to you: [/b]Your constructive feedback and constant help make us improve. Thank you very much for your support and pats on the back, let's keep going in this direction!

notes.title: Chronos Builder Update 1.3.1 - New Alien assets and more!
notes.content:
[h1]1. - WISHING WELL COMES TOMORROW![/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/482/972/eaf4b0e0627dc64156cb77bb995d4099_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680614049&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=545de888293c9c3bca43d5b644602e05[/img]

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chronos-builder/chronos-builder-wishing-well?ref=card

This is our last chance to bring it up before the campaign goes live.

Don't forget to sign up so that you are notified once it starts! You don't want to miss out on those juicy early bird pledge levels 🤩.

Once again, we'd like to remind you that we will continue to support the current version of Chronos Builder and update it with all system updates unlocked via the Wishing Well expansion! The only exclusive content will be asset packs.

We can't wait to share with you all of the cool things we have planned for Wishing Well. See you on the other side!!

[h1] 2. - New Alien Assets and Eastern Nature Props[/h1]

[b]The new Alien environment is here![/b]

This too was one of the promised stretch goals from the original campaign...crazy how far we've come🥳. We put some extra love in the design of this asset pack and decided to change the way the floor tiles work: They are arranged in groups of 4 and have an emissive effect that animates across the entire plane. Perfect for video exports!!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/482/919/4b6949cb367f88cddfa9c1734e74450e_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680613792&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=abecc7aaf6d0181ee4e37a91a4338b2d[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/482/915/7ace7f1f07280a3128ea8cebb3b5489d_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680613769&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=17229528ac7b843ab10972deeabc8f27[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/482/931/4f787a14f77f5ac39c273f1d9b818d64_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680613830&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=8e53482b89b5ae8b730274d378dd74fb[/img]

[b]New Eastern Nature Props[/b]

Something we planned to include in the latest patch but didn't have enough time to squeeze in. Thankfully, It's only been a couple of weeks since then so the wait wasn't as long.

You can access them through the Nature Paint mode inside the Terrain Tool!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/483/101/4e58b64d5189cf0aedcc0822d92cdd9e_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680614630&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=11b4d5fcfc4e8a827e810fcd73eeb5de[/img]

[h1]3. - Export update: Print mode[/h1]

The export systems also received some love in this update (this is becoming a trend now haha).

[b]- New Print Mode: [/b]Added Print mode to the export menu. Export your maps so they fit in standardized pages according to your preferred tile size. The system will calculate the optimal page orientation according to the size of your map.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/483/031/765d35e2fe3c236e0b5c5a75f062280e_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680614307&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=f388d0f44ad3dc1bc419b9ddcaa5f56a[/img]

[b]- Rotation and Zoom configuration: [/b]Simple as that! You can now use the sliders to modify the zoom and rotation of your capture.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/483/034/d67bcbd4678c4f137828c4701b4f3731_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680614318&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=c0fe9038d348df687051a65a18a04a09[/img]

[h1]4. - Quality of life changes[/h1]

[b]- Water under assets: [/b]Added a new system that prevents some assets from modifying the terrain. This will make it so that you can create liquid or modify the terrain beneath them. Assets affected include: Bridges, Ceiling Lamps, Plants, Rocks, Wood Logs, Sci-Fi Spaceships, Sci-Fi Evelated Pathways, Victorian Boats. We intend to expand this system in the future so you can manually configure which assets affect the terrain via the tweaks menu.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/483/221/e53d17619280ab89422981d7718d5a59_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680615252&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=efa56ab42d960b70a431e85ed9b1019a[/img]

[b]- Clickthrough System:[/b] This solves a common issue of multiple assets being stacked on top of each other, with one preventing the selection of the other. You can now continue clicking to select the item behind or on top of the current selection. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/483/391/ba9555b288064daff05788f9bc077de5_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680616191&gif-q=50&q=92&s=816108336c65ff53caf509f1e1bdd9e7[/img]

Note that this doesn't solve the known issue of regular assets preventing the selection of floor planes, something we intend to solve in the next patch.

[b]- New Structure Replace System: [/b]The structure replace system has been updated. While previously it'd only replace an asset if it was highlighted with the cursor, now it'll check if it's either highlighted or close enough to the current asset being spawned. Additionally, You can also replace floor planes and columns now plus You'll now see a tooltip indicating whenever a replacement action is possible.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/483/311/3f8d8653f77c85009c8cbb0855677522_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680615729&gif-q=50&q=92&s=4cbbc1d2e260682c83a92cfabd63ca1a[/img]

[b]- New Background Plane: [/b]We decided to add a new background plane of a darker tone to help highlight your creations! You might have seen a preview of it already if you checked a recent mail we sent to all backers. Looks beautiful, don't you think? You can always disable it via the Terrain Tool menu.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/482/953/58f41696e215075623d6109a55643874_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680613939&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=73b028d073aeaa735cb5690531bea71c[/img]

[h1]5.- What's next? Chronos Builder's roadmap[/h1]

Once again, we are starting our campaign for the new Expansion pack tomorrow, but that doesn't affect our current roadmap! Here are our plans:

[b]- Regarding the last stretch goals: [/b]We are currently hard at work on the Sci-Fi Moon Base assets, which should be out in the next big content update we release around May. After that, there are only 2 Cyberpunk environment packs left which we intend to release through the summer. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/483/296/abe0b6cfe22474b9b2eff00939e3bc45_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1680615659&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=bf0a5d3be378d1641fcf062ca66c793e[/img]

Again, now that we are so close to completing all of the stretch goals set during the original campaign, we'd like to reiterate how thankful we are that you stuck with us through this journey! 

Oh and if you are sad that we won't release any new assets after that, then worry not! The Wishing Well expansion pack is filled with lots of new cool Settings that we hope you'll help us fund!

[b]- Regarding the Autobuilder: [/b]As we mentioned last time, we're planning a big autobuilder update which should release around the end of this month! We are focusing on creating an algorythm that will spawn more meaningful room compositions by focusing on the key central elements (such as a Bar counter in a restaurant) and spawning the complementary assets starting from that origin point.

[b]- Regarding Bugfixing and Quality of life updates: [/b]There are still lots of changes we intend to bring that'll make map making even easier. There are some specific areas that need some extra work such as multi-selection movement and general system performance when loading the entire library. Our plan regarding this hasn't changed. We intend to continue to release regular updates every month or so!

[b]- Regarding Linux: [/b]We have found several issues with the Linux version of Chronos. We are working very hard on them, but right now, we cannot guaranteed its release before May. We apologise for the inconvenience, and we ask you to be patience in this regard. Thank you very much.

[h1]6.- Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Additions:[/b]

    • Added new Alien environment Assets.
    • Added new Eastern Nature Props.
    • Added Print mode to the export menu. Export your maps so they fit in standardized pages according to your preferred tile size.
    • Added Zoom and rotation options to Image and Video export menus.
    • Added additional feedback to the export process. 
    • Added a new system that prevents some assets from modifying the terrain. This will make it so that you can create liquid or modify the terrain beneath them. Assets affected include: Bridges, Ceiling Lamps, Plants, Rocks, Wood Logs, Sci-Fi Spaceships, Sci-Fi Evelated Pathways, Victorian Boats.
    • Added new Click-Through system: You can now select assets that are stacked on top of each other by clicking multiple times on them.
    • Added new background plane. You can enable or disable it from the terrain tool.

[b]Fixes:[/b]

    • Fixed Export menu not showcasing which mode is currently selected.
    • Fixed Community menu not showcasing which submenu is currently open.
    • Fixed Tools buttons getting disorganized in expanded mode.
    • Fixed non video export options not showing feedback after a successful export.
    • Fixed “Restaurant Floor” and “Restaurant Floor (Square)” duplicating themselves when loading a map.
    • Fixed “Restaurant Floor (Square)” preview icon.
    • Fixed “Shelving” asset vertical position.
    • Fixed multi file export on perspective mode so it generates all files with the same perspective.
    • Fixed double walls and windows not having the same horizontal offset.
    • Fixed Asset info not loading if you hold left mouse click over an asset slot.
    • Fixed eastern garden walls and fences not being aligned at the edge of tiles.
    • Fixed an issue that’d select multiple grids if an item movement action is cancelled with the Esc key.
    • Fixed multi struct spawn rotation for initial and current assets.
    • Fixed rotation and scale commands not always working correctly on Undo and Redo actions.
    • Fixed an error that would constantly re-open the quick palette menu whenever the a new tool menu is selected.
    • Structure spawn replace system fixes:
        ◦ Replace detection now checks if the target structure is highlighted by the cursor or close enough to the current spawn asset.
        ◦ Fixed floors not replacing each other.
        ◦ Fixed Columns not replacing each other.
        ◦ Added Tooltip feedback on replace actions.
        ◦ Fixed an issue that prevented 2x1 walls from being correctly replaced by 1x1 walls on certain rotations.
        ◦ Original desired rotation is restored after the replace after exiting the replace state.

[b]Warning:[/b]

    • Due to double walls horizontal offset fix, previous maps may have those assets moved from their intended position. Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Chronos Builder Update 1.3.0 - Item Editing + Terraforming Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]0. - Surprise Intermission: The future of Chronos Builder[/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/300/253/1d58a95ccca67da27d26c8a87dcf40df_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679309811&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2edcd421976b938654a9c5b636a1dcca[/img]

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chronos-builder/chronos-builder-wishing-well


Introducing the first Chronos Builder expansion: Wishing Well.
This is a project that we've had in the works for a long time and we're really excited to finally unveil it!!
Wishing Well will bring new exclusive asset packs alongside software updates for base Chronos Builder that will help you reach new heights with your map making (in more ways than one😉).
Make sure to click follow on the Kickstarter page so you'll be notified once it finally goes live!
On that note, lets get  back to the regularly scheduled programming... lets see what version 1.3.0 brings!!

[h1]1. - New Eastern Setting assets in version 1.3.0![/h1]

The new Eastern setting assets have arrived!

This one was the last stretch goal unlocked but we decided to give it a bump in priority and finish it ahead of the rest because we were super excited to see how the Community would mix and match it with other settings.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/300/048/39ecef34bfd14cab24a92e104eb33c99_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679308423&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=322d5fd8e98eb46b60f131b1beb09e27[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/300/063/67093be011e237845763686b82c8199c_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679308531&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=6ce01806d96de897d8f1e637ffc3332b[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/300/050/94709195ee1dea5cc89733d771c2873c_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679308455&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=a1181fddab645231430c9dc949915a51[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/300/052/05fd824a84c574cfda4368d22ee5d91b_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679308478&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=a375fe57f20abe36fb8097d0778d5954[/img]

[h1]2. - Item editing 2.0 is here![/h1]

The new item editing system lets you Rotate, Scale and Move items all in one click without the need to switch between modes. It feels far more intuitive and responsive to use.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/708/fa2b4d34cbf336a141c1a295ce1347cc_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679298033&gif-q=50&q=92&s=3f7d145887d00f882e981971bc384c76[/img]

To rotate an asset, simply click and drag the rotation gizmo. The asset will rotate proportionally to the movement of your mouse around the selection in set radial increments . It will replicate both the direction and the angles moved by your mouse.

The scaling action is also easy to get around. You'll see new bounding gizmos now show up around your selected assets. Hold and drag them outwards to increase in scale or inwards to reduce it.

 As always, you can hold down the Shift key to freely rotate or scale without constraints.

The movement iself hasnt changed much, you may click and drag an asset to place it wherever you wish. However there are some added quality of life changes related to movement, such as restoring the original position if you cancel the movement action by pressing the Esc key or by dragging it outside the grid bounds.

Here at the studio we've been tooling with the new Item Editing tools for some time now and its a night and day comparison when put next to the old system! Im sure you'll agree 😀.

The second big update to editing is: Multi-Item Tweaks configuration!

This one has also been a long time coming and will be a life saver for all those of you who love to add multiple levels to your maps. Not much to explain, just select multiple assets and adjust their configuration on the Tweaks Panel on the left side of the screen!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/703/b627cae42770e083239e520df71cc0b0_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679297996&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a2d6a7328eec9660f8c76ba4ec614fb2[/img]

OH! And there's also one final thing:

While spawning structural assets, you may now draw a selection of grids and you'll spawn said asset across all of them! This feature is similar to the Advanced Autobuilder feature that lets you spawn only floors, walls, etc. More convenient within the Structural Tool, dont you think! Currently only enabled for 1x1walls, windows, doors and floor tiles.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/692/77b0ecfe8a8c35847c67ddcc89967558_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679297939&gif-q=50&q=92&s=eb0731988b80bca39424aa8ee8ec3772[/img]

[h1]3. -  Water? Inside my grid?? New Terraforming features[/h1]

You read that right!

I bet this one is a bit of a surprise as we didnt talk about it in the latest update!! Those who have been more tuned to our socials got to see a preview a few days ago and probably saw it coming 😉.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/676/deec2588c82411ad34716a12e89cbef1_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679297824&gif-q=50&q=92&s=dc45f3991b02792ffdd8004119c5a71e[/img]

This feature is coming hot right off the oven as its not something we originally planned for this patch...Well nevermind that! The stars have aligned in such way that we managed to get it to a stable-enough state for release.

Chances or some weird bug breaking the terrain system: critically low (and yet, you always manage to amaze us with your game breaking skills so we'll see 🤣). 

Either way, the leap in map making is so big with this feature that we didnt want to have you wait another extra month to get it. You can see for yourself:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/671/3a06da3e008a36bb8c6398b436723459_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679297783&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=d597130ce72f6ef545161ca2d2c6e082[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/662/46b88cc0001a8b8bd9d5a7b408ff948b_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679297729&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=de94df04265dff5568236da08eee303a[/img]

Happy Terraforming!

But that's not all, we've got many more things regarding the Terrain Tool:

[h2]New Liquid Options:[/h2] You can now choose to have either Acid or Magma in your map! Perfect for those planning a dangerous encounter for their players 😈.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/644/cd50ee8800fadc9f54a105aafc8c269b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679297557&gif-q=50&q=92&s=6d3a786c834cf21c57442ede9ba4bd19[/img]

[h2]Sliders on brush configurations:[/h2] The artists at our studio kept begging for these and they were right! Sliders feel far more intuitive that using "+/-" buttons to change the scale of your brush.

[h2]Paint Bucket feature: [/h2]You may also use this new button to paint your entire terrain in a single texture at once!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/643/57a42f654a2147da0c280aca8116372c_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679297537&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=5a53c6e986243d9c536c5187d9e6f9a0[/img]

[h1]4. -  Community update! Edit options and more!![/h1]

The online features are receiving a lot of quality of life changes in this new patch too alongside other features that have been asked by a lot of people! 

We'll start with the big one:

[h2]Editable/Non editable options: [/h2]As a map creator in our community, you may now choose if you want others to be able to edit your map! Alternatively, you can just upload it as non-editable content in you want to show off and still give people the option to export your map for a roleplaying session. Reminder that either way, people who download your map won't be able to upload it again to the community.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/638/5b81e31ee8e52626c23e2e14a997ee79_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679297505&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=e7f9977721abe6b5869f662b6ceb3e9b[/img]

[h2]Sorting options:[/h2] We couldn't decide on the right way to organise maps on the community menu so we'll instead let you choose! You can now sort by Trending, Recent, Most Subscriptions and Best Valued maps!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/628/bee39fb51043b9dcb7df159f2ad48560_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679297461&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=02ae953d47ff679fdd44467d17de102a[/img]

[h2]New Quality of life features: [/h2]Among other things, you can now drop your map from the Steam workshop directly without the need to open it first. Additionally, you'll see new icons on your map library to let you know whether they've been downloaded or uploaded to the workshop by yourself.

[h1]5. -  Autobuilder update! New Layout and configurations![/h1]

The Autobuilder menu has been expanded to allow for a more structured props and Advanced Options menu (new juicy options we'll get to in a bit). 
The  "Build" button will now show up only when it needs to, on top of the selected grids too!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/561/c88389e0e6a121bba5fabe0a27e26a20_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679296971&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=ea393e38d0f1bb5efebe186178563d43[/img]

[h2]New Advanced options: [/h2]We are giving you more control over the algorithm. You can now control the ratio of doors and windows spawned per grid. Additionally, you can choose if you want a morre structured or random prop placement. With the Structured option making it so that items are more coherent between each other, for example by spawning only a type of chair or table.

[h2]New Quality of life features (because everything is getting these now haha): [/h2]A new warning animation will let you know if you havent configured your Autobuilder options before spawning a new room. Additionally, you may now click outside the grid bounds or select the "Esc" key to clear your grid selection.

[h1]6. -  Export update[/h1]

Last but not least important!
[h2]Foundry mp4 export: [/h2]You can now choose if you want to export to Foundry using mp4 or webm video formats.

[h2]Menus will collapse whenever you open te export menu: [/h2]Both the library and tweaks menu will close down so that you get a better view of what you are about to export, They'll resume their previous state once you close the menu.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/550/c5dd3f141ca29adce291247d335e8da2_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679296860&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b20a9fb195102aff35c05927523fe4ca[/img]

[h2]Better quality on webm export: [/h2]You were loud and clear about this on the last patch and we've listened!

[h1]7. - What's next?[/h1]

Currently, Wishing Well is the biggest project we have in mind in regards to Chronos Builder. We envision an expansion that will bring new content to everyone, even those who choose to remain only with Chronos Builder.
Once again, we'd love for you to sign up to the Kickstarter site!

In the meantime, what's our more direct roadmap? 
We acknowledge there's still work to do if we truly want to make Chronos Builder the best map making tool but you cant say we arent putting in the work towards changing that. 😉

[h2]Full-on Autobuilder Rework: [/h2]As Chronos Builder has grown, we've realized that our algorithm for procedural building wasnt good enough and the time investment in training it grew exponentially the more assets we introduced to the point were we decided to pursue other solutions. For some time now we've been planning a rework for the system. We have a dedicated programmer working full time on updating it an we hope to have ressults by the next time there's an update!

[h2]Multi item editing fixes: [/h2]There's one final thing we need to take care of before we are done with the item editing tool! Currently, the multi-selection doesnt always work as intended and will sometimes missalign assets to their grids, even if the user isnt using the gridless mode. This is something we hope we can change in the next patch!

[h2]Alien Environment: [/h2]This one is a big fan favourite and we're putting some extra love in it with very creative assets that out art team has been making! Here's a sneak peak 👀:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/298/540/11f906361940ba30a9b78cd483931b6e_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679296717&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=1c607bd298d2143b3bd86defe3eaf923[/img]

[h2]Camera Tool: [/h2]The camera system is the last item in the toolbar that needs to be implemented. We plan to have a menu that will allow you to store camera positions and toggle between them at any moment. Coupled with a more free-form first person mode, it'll be perfect for VTT players!

[h1]8.- Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Ver 1.3.0[/b]

        [h2]​ Additions:[/h2]
    • Added new “Eastern” Setting Assets and folder!
    • [b]Item Editing Additions:[/b]
        ◦ Added New Item Editing gizmos. Rotate, Scale and move items all in one click without the need to switch between modes.
        ◦ Original Item position is now reset if a given item is dragged and dropped outside the grid bounds.
        ◦ Original Item position is now reset if movement action is cancelled via “Esc” key.
        ◦ You can now drag structural assets during spawn actions to create multiple of them. Currently only enabled for 1x1 walls, windows, doors and floor tiles.
[b]    • Tweaks Editor Additions:[/b]
        ◦ Multiple items can now be modified at the same time. Position, rotation and scale changes affects the entire selection of items instead of only the first one picked.
        ◦ Rotation buttons have been enabled for all three axis, and should work without much problem. 
[b]    • Terraforming Additions:[/b]
        ◦ Added Magma and Acid liquid options and liquid selection menu.
        ◦ New Terraforming mask feature:
            ▪ You can now change the terrain elevation and paint liquid within grids as long as they aren’t occupied by assets!
            ▪ Version 1.2.0 maps and earlier will be adapted to the new system whenever the map is loaded.
        ◦ Added UI sliders to brush configuration menu.
        ◦ Added UI button that lets the user paint the entire terrain in a single texture.
[b]    • Autobuilder Additions:[/b]
        ◦ Percentage of doors and windows can now be set in the Advanced Autobuilder options, and the default percentage was modified for better generation.
        ◦ Added a command to clear current grid selection in the Autobuilder tool whenever the user clicks outside of the grid bounds or by pressing the “Esc” key.
        ◦ Updated Autobuilder UI.
        ◦ New warning animation whenever the user doesn’t have any selected Autobuilder configuration.
        ◦ Additional randomness introduced. Items should now spawn throughout the entire room instead of focusing around one corner. 
[b]    • Taskbar Additions:[/b]
        ◦ Added “Select all light sources” command.
        ◦ Added “Reset terrain” command.
[b]    • Community Additions:[/b]
        ◦ Restricted uploads of unnamed maps, maps with very few assets and maps with short names.
        ◦ Added options for private and non editable maps.
        ◦ Added sorting options to the community library: Trending, Recent, Most Subscriptions and Best Valued.
        ◦ Added icons to Load Map Menu for uploaded and downloaded maps from the Workshop.
        ◦ Added an option to drop maps directly from the Community Menu.
    • Updated sliders in sound configuration menu.
    • Added Foundry video export with mp4.
        ​ [h2]Fixes:[/h2]
    • Fixed the desktop application logo.
    • Improved overall performance.
    • Improved Terrain tool performance.
    • Updated UI graphics for multiple menus.
    • Fixed an error that would freeze the program if an item was selected upon switching to the Autobuilder tool.
    • Fixed an error that would cause the Tweaks menu to work in unexpected ways if an item is edited right after being placed.
    • Fixed an error that would cause the Tweaks menu to edit multiple items at once even if they were not selected.
    • Fixed multi selection not working if the selected grids included unwanted assets.
    • Fixed text on some Autobuilder menus that read “Null” instead of “None”.
    • Fixed text size of map tags within the global configuration menu. 
    • Added tooltips to map tags within the global configuration menu. 
    • Fixed the color of multiple UI elements to resemble that of the Chronos Builder logo.
    • Fixed an error that prevented q/e commands from rotating placed assets while using the movement action.
    • Fixed an error that allowed the user to select map items while the map was loading.
    • Fixed an error that would prevent grid size text from resetting after it had been changed in the Global Options menu.
    • Added a button that lets you load maps direction from their thumbnail in the Load menu.
    • Fixed an error that prevented grouped and custom assets from being copy-pasted.
    • Added tooltips to explain Steam’s Rating system.
    • Community search bar is now reset after opening and closing the menu.
    • Fixed an error that prevented light toggle option from working correctly when multiple assets where selected at once.
    • Fixed an error that prevented Rain and Dust Storm weather effects from being visible in tabletop camera modes.
    • Fixed Chronos Builder logo displayed in the credits.
    • Changed webm export codec to VP9 for better video quality.
    • Fixed VTT screenshot algorithm so it does not rely on resolution changes.
    • Fixed new maps generating a local file before saving them for the first time.

notes.title: Chronos Builder Update 1.2.0 - Video Export + New environments!
notes.content:
[h1]Fort and Market environments[/h1]

Take your medieval maps to the next level with these brand new assets!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/967/620/322fd774a720c252684876be21dcf1ee_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1676533457&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=fc8d0c2dcc51489eae801e7b42568131[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/967/659/9ad2f31aaed325b3ff339cc89e10c642_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1676533925&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=c3ec9abaeba777edd8ffb0b5400cb7b8[/img]

[h1]Get ready for video export![/h1]

You can finally export your creations to .mp4 and .webm formats.
Additionally, you can choose the webm video option when exporting to Foundry VTT!

Happy gaming :)

[h1]UI Overhaul[/h1]

We've slowly been changing the UI to better fit our new direction in favour of a more user-friendly experience. This update comes fully packed with some very notable changes that we hope you enjoy!

For starters, we changed the "Community" menu and went for a look that's more consistent with the rest of the UI. We removed the "favourite" option to simplify things and changed all mentions of "Subscribe" to "Save" to better explain how the system worked.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/959/012/9def4d37eb52d6002e15348e39379fb5_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1676472208&gif-q=50&q=92&s=32bf161b0d3cf88406b5a420f1ded65f[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/959/031/58b921b932ef6afd951f57086c512450_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1676472330&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c3e24ce6c670eb1f32697e55c5e83411[/img]

You can also load up a map in a single click now, whereas previously you needed to be subscribed first to see the "load" button.

We are planning some more changes for the entire online system but those will have to wait a bit longer. ;)

Outside of that, we changed multiple other things from the in-game UI:

[b]- Smaller Icons and consistant size across all other menus: [/b]We feel the "General options" and "Hide menu" buttons were a tad bit too big so we went ahead and changes those to free up some space in your screen. 

[b]- Simplified quick palette: [/b]We decided to hide the "Remove item" button from the Quick Palette slots whenever they dont have any item assigned. Simple, right? We did a whole lot more with the Quick Palette, but you'll read about it later!.  

[b]- Folder menu and Custom folders:[/b] Custom folders now have a blue tint in their name to stand apart. The "Add folder" and "Remove folder" buttons have also relocated to free up some space and you'll only get to see the "Remove folder" button whenever you have selected a custom folder. Oh! The folder menu has also changed in size to fit 5 entries in view at all times.  


[h1]Quality of life changes[/h1]

Continuing with the changes from the last update, we bring you a lot of features that will make your life simpler! These are the kind of things you dont really notice are there but it truly feels like night and day if you go back to an older version of CB (Errrr...lets not talk about the past tho).
Here's a run-down of some of the most important quality of life changes! 

[b]- You now get to see what you are dragging!:[/b] Ok, let me explain! From now on, whenever you drag an item over the ui or outside the grid section, you'll see its icon right under your mouse. This on its own is pretty handy, but wait til you hear about how it interacts with some of the other changes!! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/958/615/ac32da3a2f2f6847a2216ca2c43a15f7_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1676469062&gif-q=50&q=92&s=906744c7cb27f2698171a1166b52a35a[/img]

[b]- Custom folders and custom assets: [/b]This is a underutilized feature with a lot of potential and we decided it was probably due to how unintuitive it was. In order to fix this we added tooltips wherever it was possible. There's also a feedback animation to let you know you can drop the asset if you wish to add it to the selected folder. What do you think? 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/958/661/c3c83bb681da09b7c5d44e5fa14073e0_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1676469495&gif-q=50&q=92&s=dbf36626dadc6cfaa981d455554c92b0[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/958/773/0d4b668b8cd6c8ca84ec0fbdac6cff3d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1676470792&gif-q=50&q=92&s=d844dbcb2c1d7ed3164a7a1e18641e35[/img]


[b]- Quick Palette: [/b]This UI element also makes use of the same feedback animation mentioned above. Lets keep it consistent! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/958/681/7a0f9b2e2f298a4a696f233108091907_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1676469681&gif-q=50&q=92&s=08a636fe53bee138b3d8643e82330573[/img]

[b]-Remove Item Button: [/b]Both the quick Palette and custom folders will also make use of this greyout highlight to let you know exactly what you are about to delete. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/958/728/c16b86cd289aad206c40bf85df2d6c1d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1676470259&gif-q=50&q=92&s=00a4935d3a058fa97b9e98f5e624fe3c[/img]

[b]- Better Tutorials: [/b]We updated them to reflect the most recent changes and new tools that have been added since release. This felt like a "Must-have" to help ease new players into map making! We are considering to add video demos showcasing the functionality of each tool but that was outside the scope of this update. Let us know if that's something you'd like to see!

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]

As we promised in the last update, we bring you some more performance improvements that will be specially felt when switching from tool menus, specially the props, structure and autobuilder tool.

We also noticed some stutters while going through the tutorials. Those should be gone now.

Hooray for a smoother experience!!!

notes.title: Chronos Builder Update 1.1.0 - Nature Painting & MacOs support!
notes.content:
[h1] Nature painting is here![/h1]

You can now access the nature painting mode from the Terrain tool! This is the last missing piece, you can finally bring your environments to its final form!!!
Use it to paint nature props such as trees, stones (or mushrooms) across your map. You may select as many of them as you wish to paint them in one go.  Use a bigger radius to make props spawn randomly within the brush or instead go for a smaller one to finely select where you want to place that one pine tree! Brush intensity values also control the rate at which props will be placed.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/800/509/7733259465cc7d6b4e9f0eb336a83600_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1675073186&gif-q=50&q=92&s=cf7c8edfcc7ee5f06f0af7086c8a4121[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/800/192/b0ac9f3266e86e5d172622a211db99b9_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1675069882&gif-q=50&q=92&s=f4a269305d99aad6673771662ecd49eb[/img]

Just one last thing...we're calling them "nature props" but you can actually be a total meanie and place other things such as trash, fallen papers or debris! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/800/583/67910bb4a7b0de33ebb4792d1897d4c2_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1675073915&gif-q=50&q=92&s=aa788238627b5687480821c5319ff109[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/800/627/436ba021ca833d3bb49ba7cc3bf72a4b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1675074520&gif-q=50&q=92&s=3daa6bda3f34ae861bf695d534b2893d[/img]

[h1]Improved Translations[/h1]

We heard you loud and clear! Its about time we finally updated some of the text translations.

We worked with professional translators for the French and Deutsch texts! That means no more typos (hopefully....not until our programmers had new text tooltips...)YAY!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/799/616/c418706c7dc13c461e542d813967d061_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1675064891&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=8d09078a4e1ff7d6c01b40c3131e28cd[/img]

[h1]Usability and Quality of life changes[/h1]
Other than adding new features to the game, usability is our top priority right now!

We know Chronos Builder is not as simple to use as we'd like it to be. That's why we worked hard to solve this as soon as possible! Here are some of the changes you'll get to experience with the latest update:

[b]- Advanced and Simplified autobuilder modes: [/b]We added two distinct autobuilder modes to let you choose how in depth you want to go with your procedural building! The simplified mode only asks that you select the setting, environment and type of room you want to create, while the advanced mode is the one you are already familiar with that lets you choose the floor, wall, pillar and room props.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/778/604/4051630cf8ba8660f77d3b4520545a03_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1674833977&gif-q=50&q=92&s=69f92027828f8c9ce39dd73183be7fb2[/img]

[b]- Autobuilder mode won't override already placed elements (if you so wish): [/b]We heard your complaints that in multiple cases you only wanted to generate new floor tiles or walls for your rooms but the tool would override everything already placed within that space. Well, thankfully that is over now :). You may use the advanced autobuilder mode and it will only override that which you ask for it to place. You only want to spawn new floor tiles? Worry not, the already placed props, walls and columns will remain there!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/800/903/63cf6a9946f7fe80298b10c85c6131a8_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1675077217&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ae35785dadb9d512ce7ccc5f2f8f554a[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/800/917/94e8404cf121d98877cbfd77988d5989_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1675077356&gif-q=50&q=92&s=327ec4568aa5eee9e2405e73ab4546a2[/img]

[b]- Command Tips will be displayed on the menu while editing items:[/b] We realize some users didn't know the commands to edit items and this was frustrating to them. We hope this is a change for the better and solves the main problems while we address the other issues with the control scheme! The editing controls are still not perfect and we are looking to change the rotation and scaling options but that will take some more time.

[b]- Item editing commands have changed so that they don't coincide with camera movement commands: [/b]In a previous update we made it so that you could move your camera using the WASD keys and this would interfere with the "W" key that was used to enable to rotation command. This has been fixed now as editing commands have had new keys assigned.

[b]- Tweaks menu won't open up whenver you mouse-over items in the library: [/b]Thank the almighty spaghetti monster!! The tweaks menu is big enough for it to constantly pop in and out of existence as you browse through the library. Now we simply display the item name as a tooltip. The entire tweaks menu will still show up whenever you click on the item slot though, in order to let you place it and read its tags.

[b]- You can rotate already placed items using the q/e commands: [/b]This was already an option in the item spawning  mode and it didnt feel right that there was a divide between the commands while spawning then commands when editing already placed items.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/799/647/f99a1333a95d92d48df6d194bfef5c2d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1675065312&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5d6e49585a5c880d96c5cc026b1590ba[/img]

[b]- Camera movement works while placing items and while browsing the library: [/b]Previously it was disabled in both cases and, for example, you could not use WASD to move your camera while the mouse was over the item library. Fixed now.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/778/483/0fae8eda189cdb6bec129019bb329b0d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1674833301&gif-q=50&q=92&s=051f70865fc8369fb6811594f00de62a[/img]

[b]- You can cancel item spawn mode while dragging it: [/b]Its what feels most natural and again, something that was overlooked on our end.

[b]- New loading screen: [/b]You'll see we did a bit of a rework to some UI elements (more on that later...)! ! The loading screen is now different. We decided to go for a classic loading bar. It should also provide for a smoother transition whenever you load a new map.
